lina: Heads-up: onboarding for KiteLabs is hitting lots of 429s at SDK init during their UI rollout.

matt: Likely ephemeral token fanout. Org? sample request?

lina: org_ktl_94. Example: `POST /v1/sdk/init` with `Authorization: Bearer sk_test_ephemeral_*` minted per page load. They had ~600 parallel starts.

irene: What do the rate headers show?

lina: `x-rw-rl-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-rl-reset: 14`, body `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":14}`.

matt: Quick actions: advise client to reuse ephemeral tokens for 20-30s and add jittered backoff. We can also apply a short temporary preflight QPS bump.

irene: Approving temp relief. sam, can you add +50 preflight QPS for 15m to org_ktl_94?

sam: deploy-bot: applied temporary +50 preflight QPS to org_ktl_94 for 15m. Monitoring enabled.

lina: Sent customer a minimal snippet to reuse token + retry with jitter. Scheduled enablement call tomorrow 10am PT to walk through it.

matt: Created ENG INF-1124 to explore preflight coalescing and auto-backoff heuristics.

irene: After the bump 429s dropped significantly in the last 3m.

matt: Marking renewal risk as "low-medium" in account health until ramp completes; note mitigation steps.

lina: Follow-ups: confirm SDK change deployed, monitor for 1h, escalate if >5% 429s. Keeping thread for call notes. :thumbsup:
